name: Nmap scan
description: Hosts, systems and open ports from an Nmap scan saved as XML (nmap -oX)
author: Solid Geeks

file.label: Import an Nmap scan
file.help: Run the scan with -oX to save it as XML, for example: nmap -sV -O -oX scan.xml 10.20.0.0/24. Hosts that are up are matched to the assets of the IS by IP, then by name; their open ports become the listening ports of their applications. Nothing is removed.

fields.label: IS the scanned hosts belong to
Create the hosts missing from the map
Fill in the system Nmap detects when the asset has none
